name: Stoner doom fuzz
desc: Maximum two-stage fuzz, very dark tone, full lows: slow, down-tuned riffs into a loud amp

refs.why: fuzz into walls of cranked Orange amps
dark, saturated fuzz for down-tuned doom riffs

notes: Lows left in on purpose (no tight): the riff should rumble. The amp only crunches; the fuzz is the sound
